experiments.label: / EXPERIMENT
experiments.heading: Would you recognize manipulation under pressure?
experiments.supporting: A short live probe from the Cognitive-Behavioral Security line — feel how urgency, authority, and loss cues stack before a financial action.
experiments.probeBody: Unusual transfer detected. Confirm identity within 45 seconds to prevent account freeze.
experiments.probeResultCaught: You refused under pressure — protective pause held.
experiments.probeResultMissed: You confirmed under stacked cues — a common vulnerability pattern.
experiments.probeHint: This is a safe laboratory simulation. No data is sent.
experiments.researchLink: HOW WE STUDY DECISIONS UNDER PRESSURE →
experiments.disclaimer: Educational research demonstration — not a diagnostic tool.
experiments.saferCaught: Keep the pause: verify the channel independently, contact the institution through a known number, and treat countdown pressure as a signal to slow down.
experiments.saferMissed: Under stacked urgency and authority cues, delay irreversible actions. Re-open the request through an official app or hotline you already trust.
experiments.whyCaught: Refusing interrupted the pressure sequence before disclosure or confirmation.
experiments.whyMissed: Confirming under a countdown is a high-risk pattern in social-engineering scenarios — even when the message looks institutional.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: FinTechLab SPbU studies the relationship between human behavior, financial environments, digital systems, and protection.
about.body: Founded in 2025 at Saint Petersburg State University, the Laboratory of Modern Financial Technologies builds a scientific and applied base against behavioral vulnerabilities in modern financial threats. Work integrates behavioral economics, neuroscience, digital victimology, and financial-security practice — moving from experiment to technology, education, and regulatory insight.

decisionNetwork.title: THE DECISION NETWORK
decisionNetwork.heading: From stimulus to financial action.
decisionNetwork.supporting: A live map of how a financial choice forms — from the first cue to the irreversible click.
stageCopy: An external cue enters the field — message, alert, offer, authority signal.
Attention locks; meaning is assigned faster than verification can catch up.
Cognitive shortcuts tilt the frame — trust, loss, urgency, social proof.
Time and consequence compress the option space until pause feels costly.
A choice crystallizes under incomplete information and affective load.
Behavior becomes irreversible: transfer, disclosure, compliance, silence.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page describes how the FinTechLab SPbU website handles information. It is a working draft and does not replace an institutionally approved privacy policy.

sections.p: Browsing the public pages does not require an account. If you email the laboratory, we receive the content of your message and your email address.
No third-party analytics package is enabled on this site at the time of this draft.
The site does not set advertising cookies. Essential technical storage used by the browser for basic site operation may still apply.
The pressure-probe demonstration runs locally in your browser. The site states that experiment interaction data is not sent to a server.
For privacy questions related to this website, contact the laboratory using the address published in the footer.
Depending on applicable law, you may have rights to request access, correction, or deletion of personal data you have sent to the laboratory. Use the published contact channel to make such a request.

personalData.title: Personal data
personalData.intro: This draft explains personal-data handling for the FinTechLab SPbU website. It is not a substitute for an approved institutional notice.

sections.p: The public site currently does not operate a contact form that collects personal data into a database.
If you write to the laboratory by email, the laboratory processes the personal data you choose to include in order to respond.
The interactive demonstration is designed to keep interaction local to your device for the session and is presented as an educational research demonstration, not a diagnostic tool.
This website is not used to sell personal data.
Questions about personal data relating to this website can be sent via the laboratory contact address in the footer.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using this website you agree to these basic terms. This is a draft for publication readiness and awaits legal review.

sections.p: Materials on this site are research and educational. They describe laboratory work, methods, and outputs.
Nothing on this website is investment, banking, legal, or medical advice. Do not treat research demonstrations as personalized guidance.

Text, design, registered software references, and media remain the property of their respective rights holders, including Saint Petersburg State University and attributed authors, unless otherwise stated.
Links to journals, repositories, or partner sites are provided for reference. FinTechLab is not responsible for external content.
Do not misuse the site, attempt unauthorized access, or interfere with its operation.
Questions about these terms can be sent via the laboratory contact address published on the site.
